title: F169.4 flat has no depth: the overview
caption: The two windows and the talk stop writing their own depth and read the theme's names, a picture on a flat page loses its glow and its fades, and two small things found by measuring go the same way.

cards.title: F169.4 Flat has no depth
cards.text: Flat already says none for every shadow and blur. The places that never asked now ask, so a flat page shows lines and solid colours only.

cards.title: The two windows
cards.text: The search window floats by the theme's shadow, and the page behind it and the typing row take the theme's blur. The send throws the press's shadow and stands still. Steps 2 to 4.

cards.title: The talk's pieces
cards.text: A visitor's message and a code block take the theme's small shadow, and flat's message is one solid colour. Two mixins that wrote depth go. Step 5.

cards.title: A picture on a flat page
cards.text: Its glows and lights are hidden, its rails, beams and badges are one violet, and its six tone colours stay. No picture file changes. Steps 6 and 7.

cards.title: Found by measuring
cards.text: The line that says Orbi is working is plain words in flat, by one new theme value. The faint grain over every page goes everywhere. Steps 8 and 9.
